headline: Bank of South Sudan Orders Unauthorized Foreign Exchange Dealers to Regularize
summary: The Bank of South Sudan directed all unlicensed foreign exchange operators, including street dealers and informal bureaus, to regularize their operations.
why: The Bank of South Sudan is the central bank of South Sudan, responsible for monetary policy and financial sector regulation.

impacts.name: South Sudanese Pound
impacts.why: Regulatory enforcement targets unlicensed operators trading foreign exchange in the domestic currency market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
